https://careers.google.com

1. About the Organization

interact with information and one another. Our ambition is to bring world-class scale and resilience to every solution we ship.
2. Key Roles & Responsibilities
•   Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance large-scale distributed software solutions.
•   Manage individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables across multi-functional agile pods.
•   Write robust, testable, and efficient code in Java, C++, Python, or Go.
•   Collaborate with Site Reliability Engineers to monitor telemetry and scale global backend services.
3. Technical Requirements & Qualifications
•   Strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, Complexity Analysis, and Object-Oriented Design.
•   Proficiency in at least one modern language (Java, C++, Python, Go).
•   Working knowledge of relational/non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, Bigtable, Spanner).
•   Familiarity with cloud microservices, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
4. Selection & Interview Process
Step 1:   Round 1: Online Technical Assessment (Data Structures & Algorithmic Problem Solving)
Step 2:   Round 2: Technical Interview I (Data Structures, System Fundamentals & Algorithms)
Step 3:   Round 3: Technical Interview II (Architecture & Object-Oriented Design)
Step 4:   Round 4: Googleyness & Leadership / HR Fitment Round

with the employer.
